notes: WI 2025 vintage available on Justia. WI Statutes have no 'title' layer — chapters are the top-level division. Tree is 4 levels deep: state -> chapter -> section -> (leaf section page). Pass-1 picked chapter-13/ (Legislative branch); chapter-11 (Campaign financing) intentionally excluded as separate regime. Pass-2 fetch on chapter-13/ returned a section-level TSV (per-section leaves), matching WI 2010 per-section-leaf convention (Example D in the pass-2 prompt). Pass-2 directly picked the 16 lobbying sections (13.61-13.75), so pass-3 was not invoked — there is no deeper level to drill into. URL slug convention changed from 2010 ('13/13.XX.html') to 2025 ('chapter-13/section-13-XX/'); the 16 section identifiers (13.61, 13.62, 13.621, 13.625, 13.63, 13.64, 13.65, 13.66, 13.67, 13.68, 13.685, 13.69, 13.695, 13.71, 13.74, 13.75) match the 2015 ground truth exactly. All chosen URLs are section-level leaves per the batch-2 lesson (URL ends in section-13-XX/ form).
